answer.sql:
```sql
WITH claim_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment    lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve    lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holder AS (
    SELECT
        Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'Insured'
),
policy_agent AS (
    SELECT
        Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        Party_Identifier AS Agent_Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'Agent'
),
premium AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    cp.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier,
    pg.Agent_Party_Identifier,
    prem.Premium_Amount_Paid,
    amt.Loss_Payment_Amount,
    amt.Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    amt.Expense_Payment_Amount,
    amt.Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts amt ON amt.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holder ph ON ph.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_agent pg ON pg.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium prem ON prem.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Claim_Identifier;
```

Note: the provided DDL doesn't include the `Party` table definition, so policy holder and agent are returned as `Party_Identifier` values (via `Agreement_Party_Role.Party_Role_Code = 'Insured'`/`'Agent'`) rather than names — join in `Party` if it has a name column and you want that instead.

WITH claim_loss AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve)
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_claims AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number,
        cc.Claim_Identifier
    FROM Policy p
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
        ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
       AND cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
),
policy_loss AS (
    SELECT
        pc.Policy_Identifier,
        pc.Policy_Number,
        SUM(cl.loss_amount) AS total_loss
    FROM policy_claims pc
    JOIN claim_loss cl
        ON cl.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY pc.Policy_Identifier, pc.Policy_Number
)
SELECT
    Policy_Number,
    AVG(total_loss) AS average_loss
FROM policy_loss
GROUP BY Policy_Number;

answer.sql:
WITH losses AS (
    SELECT
        pcd.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_losses
    FROM Claim c
    JOIN Claim_Amount ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    GROUP BY pcd.Policy_Identifier
),
premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
agents AS (
    SELECT
        Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        Party_Identifier AS Agent_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'Agent'
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    a.Agent_Identifier,
    COALESCE(l.total_losses, 0) AS total_losses,
    COALESCE(pr.total_premium, 0) AS total_premium,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(pr.total_premium, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE COALESCE(l.total_losses, 0) / pr.total_premium
    END AS loss_ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN agents a
    ON a.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN losses l
    ON l.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premiums pr
    ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, a.Agent_Identifier;

answer.sql:
WITH claim_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier,
        CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END AS loss_payment_amt,
        CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END AS loss_reserve_amt,
        CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END AS expense_payment_amt,
        CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END AS expense_reserve_amt
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
),
claim_amount_summary AS (
    SELECT
        Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(loss_payment_amt) AS total_loss_payment,
        SUM(loss_reserve_amt) AS total_loss_reserve,
        SUM(expense_payment_amt) AS total_expense_payment,
        SUM(expense_reserve_amt) AS total_expense_reserve
    FROM claim_amounts
    GROUP BY Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium p ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holder AS (
    SELECT Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier, Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'Policy Holder'
),
policy_agent AS (
    SELECT Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier, Party_Identifier AS Agent_Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'Agent'
)
SELECT
    cl.Company_Claim_Number,
    pol.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier,
    ag.Agent_Party_Identifier,
    pp.total_premium              AS Premium_Amount_Paid,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    cas.total_loss_payment,
    cas.total_loss_reserve,
    cas.total_expense_payment,
    cas.total_expense_reserve
FROM Claim cl
LEFT JOIN claim_amount_summary cas ON cas.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy pol ON pol.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holder ph ON ph.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_agent ag ON ag.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Catastrophe cat ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = cl.Catastrophe_Identifier;

SELECT
    Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Identifier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT Agreement_Identifier) AS Policy_Count
FROM Agreement_Party_Role
WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'Policy Holder'
GROUP BY Party_Identifier;

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS Number_Of_Claims
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

WITH claim_loss AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve)
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
     AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
    SUM(COALESCE(cl.loss_amount, 0)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier), 0) AS average_loss
FROM claim_policy cp
JOIN Policy p
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_loss cl
  ON cl.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium_Amount
FROM Premium pr
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

WITH claim_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        ca.Claim_Amount,
        CASE
            WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN 'Loss_Payment'
            WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN 'Loss_Reserve'
            WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN 'Expense_Payment'
            WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN 'Expense_Reserve'
        END AS Amount_Category
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
),
claim_amount_summary AS (
    SELECT
        Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Amount_Category = 'Loss_Payment' THEN Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END)    AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Amount_Category = 'Loss_Reserve' THEN Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END)    AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Amount_Category = 'Expense_Payment' THEN Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Amount_Category = 'Expense_Reserve' THEN Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM claim_amounts
    GROUP BY Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
       AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
premium_summary AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium p ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    pol.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier,
    cas.Loss_Payment_Amount,
    cas.Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    cas.Expense_Payment_Amount,
    cas.Expense_Reserve_Amount,
    ps.Premium_Amount
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_amount_summary cas ON c.Claim_Identifier = cas.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy pol ON cp.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON pol.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
   AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'Policy Holder'
LEFT JOIN premium_summary ps ON pol.Policy_Identifier = ps.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

WITH claim_loss AS (
    SELECT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier,
        ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier,
        ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM Claim c
    JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Claim_Amount ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve)
),
policy_loss AS (
    SELECT
        Policy_Identifier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT Claim_Identifier) AS Number_Of_Claims,
        SUM(Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
    FROM claim_loss
    GROUP BY Policy_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    pl.Number_Of_Claims,
    pl.Total_Loss,
    pp.Premium,
    pl.Total_Loss / pp.Premium AS Loss_Ratio
FROM policy_loss pl
JOIN policy_premium pp
    ON pp.Policy_Identifier = pl.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pl.Policy_Identifier;
